title: Decommission Jenkins/PVE CI after the Actions cutover
body: Operator decision (2026-11-06 ~14:10Z, relayed by predecessor lead): after the GitHub Actions cutover (#247, t-6vqyhjy) KRN does not need PVE/Jenkins at all.

Do, once #247 and the required-check switch are merged and main `Check` is green:
1. Close PRs #245 (t-yg86z2m pids probe) and #246 (t-sa3sfpx reset skip) as obsolete (Jenkins/PVE-only fixes); release their claims. Keep #244 (t-3trwjr9 shard planner) only if the Actions shards use it.
2. Stop Jenkins VMs 108 and 109 on PVE — touch only those two.
3. Remove `krn/gate` (GitHub App 5548482) from krn deliver/ship/ci and docs; remove Jenkins env (KRN_JENKINS_*) paths and `krn ci rerun` Jenkins backend.
4. Retire t-sp5fbse and the `.krn/runs/lead/ci-deploy` runbook paths; drop Jenkins notes from krn-lead skill.
Proof: `git grep -n '5548482\|krn/gate\|KRN_JENKINS'` prints nothing outside history docs/ADRs; a PR delivers on Actions `Check` alone.
